interpretation: Primary: same-key E3 per H, weighted - original, weighted - posthoc2x, weighted - persistence (matched non-missing exact-origin keys, coverage reported) and posthoc2x - original. FIT is in-sample, C in-window interpolation (diagnostic). Weighted outputs are cost-sensitive scores, not calibrated posteriors; unweighted Brier / log loss are reported with no promised direction. AUC/AP are within-root and mean-fold only. Kish ESS is not an independent sample size. 21 overlapping, repeatedly developed folds: no significance test, no adoption rule; one fixed 2:1 cost.
